text_block_list.text:
One day, I saw Tokai Teio
looking feeling down.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... What went wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Trainer, guess what...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Um, Teio-san!
There's something I want to ask!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh? A question for me? Alright, I shall answer anything you desire!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Well then... straight to the point,
what's the secret behind your strength, Teio-san?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, straight to the point, huh...?
What's the matter all of a sudden? Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. We had a mock race, but...
I just wasn't satisfied with my running...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I want to run in a way that fires up the crowd,
just like Teio-san does!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So, I was hoping I could ask you, Teio-san—the one
I admire so much—about the secret to your strength...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Admiring me... I see, I see.
You want me to teach you the secret to strength, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I feel like
I might have said something similar once upon a time...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No, just talking to myself♪
Umm, back then, the President definitely...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yes! "Each possesses unique strengths, and by working diligently with unflagging devotion, one can achieve great ambitions"—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hae...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...And after all that,
I still didn't feel anything click.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whenever Prez says it,
everyone's so moved by it, though...
choice_data_list: I think what I need is your words.
I think what I need is your words.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: My own words, huh...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah, you're right. Kita-chan watched me run
and came to look up to me, after all.”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm not sure if I can speak as well as the President did back then, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should pass on my secret tips
to Kita-chan in my own words!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are!
Hey, Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Eh, um... Teio-san?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry about earlier!
I didn't study enough, so I didn't understand...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That was my fault. I just repeated what the Prez said word for word...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So I came to simply tell you the secret to my strength in my own words♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All I can say is, 'never give up on your dreams.'
No matter how badly you get knocked down.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I've decided to keep running without ever giving up
on the dream I first embraced.
That's the secret to my strength!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Never giving up is the secret to strength...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll become strong... just like Teio-san!
I definitely won't give up!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: As expected of Teio-senpai... She's so cool~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Teio-senpai's words fired me up, too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~... Did you see that?
Those juniors had such sparkling eyes~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I gotta admit, I looked pretty cool out there~♪
Right? I looked cool, didn't I?
choice_data_list: You looked so cool, just like a student council president.
Let's do our best to be someone others can look up to!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even if they're not Prez's words,
I can still cheer everyone up♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
“Still, not yet! I have to work harder
and overtake the President!”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Until then,
I'm counting on you, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm! Gotta do our best~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I know! How about I hold a lecture every single day from now on?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! Today, I shall once again teach everyone
the secret behind Teio-senpai's strength!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Why aren't you reacting at all?!
What's wrong with it? Tell me, Trainer?!
